newsitem.title: USA: J.M. Smucker sees year topping estimates.
newsitem.headline: J.M. Smucker sees year topping estimates.

text.p: J.M. Smucker Co said on Thursday that it expects to report earnings for the fourth quarter ending April 30 that surpass the year-ago quarter, and full-year earnings that would top analysts' consensus estimates.

Smucker said in a news release that it expects fourth-quarter sales to be up nearly eight percent from the same period the year before, and earnings from continuing operations to be up over 70 percent.
For the full year, sales were seen up three percent, and net income up five percent, to $1.06 per share.
Smucker said current estimates for the year ranged from $0.90 per share to $1.00 per share.
For full-year 1996, Smucker reported net income of $1.01 per share.
The company credited the results to higher sales, an effective cost-reduction effort and improved profitability in the international area.
Full results will be reported in late June.
Smucker makes branded preserves, jams, jellies and other fruit spreads, along with other food products. Its shares were up 1/2 to 17-5/8 in afternoon trading.
